Gilmore Electric: On site in am for generator manual transfer test.
Note: Transfer test and communication to scada test failed.
CC Controls & ASCO: On site from 3:00pm until 5:00pm. Switched control wiring in the RTU and generator transfer panel and corrected the automatic transfer switch and communication issues. Station is now switching automatically on power failure and sending alarm to scada.

TLC: On site in afternoon for generator manual transfer and pump remote test.
Gilmore Electric: Not on site.
Note: Transfer and pump test passed but the ultrasonic sensor test failed and station remained on bypass throughout weekend under contractor’s control. Final testing to resume next week.
CC Controls & ASCO: On site in afternoon for testing. During testing it was discovered that a communication era continued to the scada. The radio antenna connection was sealed with black tape with moisture inside. The antenna was replaced, the connection was dried and a rubber shrink wrap moisture protector was placed over the connection. This resolved the communication era.
Construction work substantially complete. Startup, testing, by-pass removal and punch list work pending.
Note: Station on by-pass pumping.
See Photos in the H:\Project Files\8052\2.2A\Folder
